method: Real detector runs with expected-rule/message assertions and two clean controls. Leave-one-out removes verdicts from this purpose-built matrix; its duration is a sum of measured clean command costs, not a timed omitted workflow or full-repository CI latency. Node/Bun cases exercise the same proxy mutation on two runtimes. Medium CodeQL findings are reported but do not block under existing policy.
localProvenance: Windows canonical source plus uncommitted candidate changes, executed through linux-task in the disposable Debian mirror. The sequential/parallel quality pair used the same earlier working-tree snapshot and unchanged quality command/fixture definitions; remote data is the authoritative commit-pinned comparison.

cache.boundary: Includes builder setup, cache export/import, image loading and inter-step overhead. Excludes post-build runtime acceptance. Each cold/warm/changed build uses a distinct builder; scopes are unique per trial. Cache hits confirmed in GitHub job logs.

rejectedFourWay.outcome: First remote clean baseline failed: client-protocol.test.ts backpressure test exceeded its unchanged 5000 ms timeout. No valid remote speedup or full defect acceptance can be claimed for this candidate.

local.command: pnpm build && concurrently --names typecheck,lint,format "pnpm typecheck" "pnpm lint" "pnpm format:check" && pnpm test

parallel.command: pnpm build && concurrently --names typecheck,lint,format "pnpm typecheck" "pnpm lint" "pnpm format:check" && pnpm test
